added.summary: Custom highlights (CSS Custom Highlight API): `og.ui.setHighlight(name, { ranges, priority })` registers ranges of laid-out text, each from a character of one element to a character of the same element or a later one, by path and offset, and `::highlight(<name>)` styles them with background-color, color, text-decoration and text-shadow, as ::selection is styled. A style reaches the elements under its rule (`:root::highlight(found)` styles them all). Overlays stack by priority under ::target-text and the selection, a tie going to the highlight registered later. It suits search hits, words a tutorial points out, and a spell checker's marks.
